title: Simple Voice Chat
what: Players nearby can talk to each other. Everyone needs the Simple Voice Chat mod in their own game too.
steps: Players install the Simple Voice Chat mod for their game (Fabric, Forge or NeoForge).
It uses its own UDP port, 24454 unless changed in its settings. Friends from the internet need that port open on the router too.
In the game, players press V to open the voice settings and make or join groups.
